```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date and time columns to datetime format
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['time'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['time'])

# Extract year and month from date column
coffee_sales['year'] = coffee_sales['date'].dt.year
coffee_sales['month'] = coffee_sales['date'].dt.month

# Plot the total sales by month
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.lineplot(x='month', y='total', data=coffee_sales)
plt.title('Total Sales by Month')
plt.xlabel('Month')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.legend(title='Year')
plt.grid(True)
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
